scope: Japanese cash equities and ETFs via Rakuten Securities/iSPEED, including odd-lot/minimum-share execution when available

capitalRules.principle: Do not exclude high-priced names because of unit price. Use odd-lot/minimum-share execution when appropriate. Position size is decided case by case from thesis strength, volatility, liquidity, event risk, portfolio concentration and downside scenario rather than a fixed yen cap.

lossRules.principle: Do not exit or skip a valid opportunity solely because a fixed yen loss threshold is reached. Before entry, define the thesis, invalidation condition, downside scenario, expected maximum loss and risk/reward. Reassess when the thesis or market structure changes.

daytradeToSwingPolicy.principle: A position entered as a day trade may be reclassified to a swing only if the investment thesis, sector/macro backdrop, price structure and expected value independently justify holding beyond the session.
requiredBeforeCarry: Re-evaluate the thesis using information available before the close
Define first and final profit objectives
Check overnight event and gap risk
Check portfolio concentration and downside scenario
daytradeToSwingPolicy.notAllowed: Do not extend holding solely because the position is in loss.

averagingDownPolicy.principle: Do not average down merely to lower average cost. Add only when the thesis remains valid, evidence improves or price/reward becomes more attractive, and the resulting portfolio downside remains acceptable.
averagingDownPolicy.repeatAdds: Avoid mechanical repeated averaging down. Each add requires a fresh committee rationale.

riskEvaluation.riskReward: Use risk/reward as a decision input, not an inflexible pass/fail threshold.

goal.note: The target does not create a fixed daily or per-trade loss cap and must not force low-quality trades.
